newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * The Central Electoral Bureau (BEC) announced the final results in Sunday's presidential run-off.
Emil Constantinescu obtained 54.41 percent and Ion Iliescu 45.59 percent of valid votes cast.
The BEC said the turnout was 75.90 percent of 17.3 million voters.
* The BEC will hand the results to the Constitutional Court, which must validate the elections.

* The National Peasant Party (PNT-CD) leadership is meeting to designate its candidates for prime minister and government ministers. Newly elected President Emil Constantinescu, a member of the PNT-CD, is attending the meeting.
PNT-CD vice-president Gabriel Tepelea said the party body would choose from five candidates, including Bucharest mayor Victor Ciorbea.

* The outgoing cabinet of Prime Minister Nicolae Vacaroiu is holding its weekly session to discus the 1997 draft state budget. The cabinet will also discus a government decree to rectify the 1996 state budget.
The cabinet is also expected to analyse the stage of energy supplies for the winter. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
